radiusSource: Radius 0.546 +/- 0.018 solar radii from Diamond-Lowe et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-3 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....164..172D/abstract): 379,852 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.549 +/- 0.029 solar masses from Diamond-Lowe et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-3 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....164..172D/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM.
